resources.string: Choose the output for each controller input. You can mix gamepad, keyboard, and mouse bindings. Only the output shown for that input is sent. This mapping is shared by all instances; save before launching your game.
These buttons replace the draft below. Every binding remains editable.
Choose an analog gamepad stick, mouse movement, or Custom direction bindings to configure up, right, down and left separately. Direction bindings only run in Custom direction bindings mode.
Shared outputs: %1$s\nThese bindings are allowed. If two inputs should do different things, change one of their outputs.

Use only if Android reports different button names from your controller. Calibration changes which input row a physical button uses; the output is still chosen above. Existing swaps are shown in those rows. Triggers, D-pad and stick movement are configured above.
Step %1$d of %2$d: press the physical button you want to use as %3$s.
That button is already assigned. Press a different button.
Use a face, shoulder, menu or stick-click button. Configure trigger and D-pad outputs in their own rows above.
Guide is reserved for its own input. Press another button.
Button calibration added to the draft. Tap Save to apply it.
Finish or cancel button calibration before saving.
Automatic checks the axis ranges reported by your controller. If the right stick behaves like a trigger or does not move, try the other axis pair. Only one pair is read.
